tools.name: gv_list_prompts
tools.description: Lists every prompt in the canonical prompt library with id, category, and title.

tools.name: gv_get_prompt
tools.description: Returns a prompt from the library exactly as written, never summarized.

tools.name: gv_list_tool_categories
tools.description: Lists the 12 categories of GrowthVector's marketing tools directory with their lists, tool counts, the scale each list is priced at, and page links, plus the directory FAQ and buying tips.

tools.name: gv_list_tools
tools.description: Returns every tool in one Resources category, list by list, lowest price first as on the page: price at the list's scale (or entry price), free option, API access, official MCP server, audience, and a link to its card. Sourced values carry their source URL; null means the vendor does not say.

tools.name: gv_get_tool
tools.description: Returns one tool's full card from the Resources directory (summary, best for, price, free tier, strength, watch-out, alternatives) and every sourced fact (pricing plans, free option, API, terms, compliance, integrations, and more) with its source URL and the vendor's own words.

tools.name: gv_list_techniques
tools.description: Lists every card of GrowthVector's Technique Graph (advanced SEO, AI search, links, paid media, analytics, email, social and privacy techniques) with its id, title, category and cluster.

tools.name: gv_get_technique
tools.description: Returns one Technique Graph card: the steps to do it, why it works (the named study, case or documentation behind it), and the related techniques it works with.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gv_list_tools, gv_get_tool, gv_list_techniques · Public sink: gv_list_techniques.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gv_list_tools, gv_get_tool, gv_list_techniques · Public sink: gv_list_techniques

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
